Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. supplied “Protein Colloid as per Specification as per specification No. IND/ ME/915(PROV). Organization/PSU /Public Listed Company before the Bid submission end date. Note: The quoting firm must submit copy of original Purchase Order issued by th e buyer along with. a) Supporting documents in support of successful supply & acceptance of minim um 60% of the ordered quantity. It should b e drawn in the favour of Chief General Manager. 4. Option Clause: + 50% option clause will be applicable 5. Bare minimum clause (-50%): In case of unreasonably higher quoted pr ices and urgency of requirement, MIL Store Procurement Manual has provi ded an option of placing order for bare minimum quantity (Qty required to meet the urgent requirements). However, GeM portal does not provide any option of procurement of bare minimum quantity as of now. In view of the above, to procure Bare Minimum quantity up to 50% of tender quantity on GeM, 50% option clause may be opted in the present bid and the same ma y be operated on lower side in case of decision of bare minimum order. 6. Delivery Period/Schedule: Complete delivery within i) 120 days from th e placement of Supply order for LTE case of quantity 13520 Kg Note: Unloading of material at site is in Contractor’s scope. 7. Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order, 2017 : Applicable 8. Public Procurement for MSEs, Order 2012: Applicable, Firm should su

bmit duly filled Annexure-N (attached) along with valid UDYAM Registration Certificate to claim purchase preference. 9. Performance Security Deposit: Applicable @ 5% of Supply Order Value & should be valid for additional period of 60 days beyond the date of compl etion of all contractual obligation including Warranty Clause (if applicable). Performance Security Deposit may be furnished in the form of Account payee D emand Draft/ Banker Cheque, Fixed Deposit Receipt from a Commercial Bank, B ank Guarantee from a Commercial Bank, Insurance Surety Bonds or online p ayment in an acceptable form safeguarding the purchaser’s interest in all respe cts. It should be drawn in the favour of Chief General Manager. PSD should be c ompulsorily in the form of BG/FDR/DD,Insurance Surety Bond from a Comme rcial Bank or online payment in an acceptable form since it will also serve as fin ancial guarantee against integrity pact. PSD in the form of Indemnity Bond will be accepted from central/state PSU.. 10. Tender Enquiry Compliance Statement: Required as per attached ann exure-M. 11. Warranty: Applicable as per item specifications if not mentioned in specifi cation warranty will be one year from date of receipt at OFI. 12. Test Certificate: The firm will provide the test certificate for each consignment 13. GST: The firms shall show applicable GST exclusively and as separate ele ments in their quotation as well as in their invoices. The firm shall submit t he relevant documents in support of the GST claim along with GST ID. OF It arsi intends to avail GST input credit. The invoices are to be submitted acc ordingly. 14. IP addresses collusion: If IP Addresses found same for different bidders on GeM portal. Then, offers of the bidders will be summarily rejected on gr ound of suspected collusion. 15. Quantity Tolerance: Quantity tolerance of +/- 5% will be applicable. Pay ment will be made accordingly. 16. Special Note: 1. Right of Access: Rep of OFI, OFI’s Customer, and other regulatory authoriti es shall have access to supplier’s facility and all other facilities involved in fulfillment of the Purchase Order, where they shall have access to all proce dures, practices, processes, associated documents, and records related to quality assurance, quality control, and configuration control. The supplier s hall notify OFI in writing to any significant facility or organizational changes such as company name, location, or senior quality management. OFI reser ves the right to audit for compliance of all the requirements. 2. Record Retention: Supplier shall retain quality records for a minimum of 20 years from the date of acceptance in OFI in original form or in electronic fo rm. The quality records include COC, Test reports, Raw Material Test report s, Special Process certifications, Route cards (if applicable) and Calibration records. This data shall be made available upon request. Records shall be appropriately identified, secured and stored properly to prevent deteriorati on or damage and to prevent loss. 3. Disposition Requirement: Supplier shall ensure that non-confirming produc

ts are identified and properly dispositioned as required by supplier’s proce dures. Only product that confirms to specified requirements shall be shipp ed to OFI. Disposition of Use As Is or Repair for products shall require writte n authorization from OFI. OFI reserves the right to audit for compliance. An y reworked parts shall be re-inspected and / or tested prior to shipment. 4. Prevention of counterfeit parts: The supplier shall have a program in place to prevent delivery of counterfeit parts and materials to OFI. All parts, mat erials and assemblies delivered to OFI shall be procured directly from OEM or their authorized dealers/distributors. If it is determined in a specific inst ance that this is not possible, the same to be intimated to OFI for their disp osition. The supplier is responsible for the flow down of this requirement to its sub-tier vendors and their compliance to it. . 3.
